policy: Retain every settled runtime output. Personal absolute repo/home paths and matching embedded JSON source maps are replaced by $REPO/$HOME; Playwright source-path and changed resource identifiers are renamed consistently. Numeric timing/frame payloads and binary media are not synthesized or edited. Original local output is not deleted. Unchanged archives are copied byte-for-byte.
legacyInlineAttachments: Early dot-reporter runs did not materialize inline-body attachments. Their output is retained as observed, without inventing missing JSON. The final recorder helper writes named raw JSON before attaching.
